title: Oracle Morning Brief
script_summary: Bitcoin slips 1.4 percent to 63,041 dollars with fear and greed at 28. Asia session offered no rebound as selling pressure held through the overnight window. Hashrate sits at 915 EH/s, underscoring miner conviction despite the dip. Mempool remains bloated at 87,714 transactions yet fees stay minimal at one sat per vbyte, signaling steady network capacity. Block 957,838 just cleared. Watch for any break below 62,500 that could accelerate liquidations or a quick bounce if spot bids reappear above
